name: Esconet Technologies Ltd.
summary: Esconet Technologies Ltd. is an Indian IT infrastructure company specializing in high-performance computing, data center solutions, and private cloud services. The company provides a range of products and services, including its proprietary Hexadata brand of servers and workstations engineered for AI, machine learning, and high-frequency trading. It offers comprehensive data center facilities, encompassing storage servers, network security, virtualization, and data protection. Through its subsidiary, ZeaCloud Services, Esconet delivers cloud solutions such as private cloud services, Infrastructure-as-a-Service, data backup, and disaster recovery. The company also trades in server components, IT products, and related peripherals, and provides virtualization software, operations and automation solutions, software-defined networks and storage, network security tools, and cybersecurity consulting via its Fluidech group company. Esconet operates as a system integrator and solution provider, targeting small and medium-sized enterprises, large enterprises, and public sector clients across diverse industries including manufacturing, education, healthcare, defence, government, logistics, legal and financial services, media and entertainment, and telecommunications, primarily within the Indian market, with some exports.
